entities.summary: Thoros I, Prince of Armenia, was a key figure in the medieval history of Armenia, playing a crucial role in the establishment of the Armenian Cilicia, a vital state in the region. Born into the Bagratuni dynasty, Thoros I ascended to the throne in 1078 and reigned until his death in 1129. During his reign, he oversaw significant military campaigns against the Seljuk Turks, securing crucial victories at the Battle of Manzikert and the Battle of Artavazt. These victories not only expanded Armenian territory but also allowed Thoros I to establish strong diplomatic relationships with neighboring states, including the Byzantine Empire. Despite the challenges posed by the Mongol invasions, Thoros I's military prowess and diplomatic acumen helped maintain Armenian independence and pave the way for the future prosperity of the Armenian Cilicia. The legacy of Thoros I continues to be felt in the modern era, with his military campaigns and diplomatic efforts serving as a testament to the enduring strength and resilience of the Armenian people. The establishment of the Armenian Cilicia under Thoros I's leadership marked a pivotal moment in the history of Armenia, one that would have far-reaching consequences for the region and its people.
